name: roleward-job-hunting
description: Help a job seeker decide which supplied opportunities deserve attention, position real experience truthfully, and keep an inspectable local record. Current public Alpha requires a local workspace and Python 3.11+ for persistence. Current-job discovery additionally requires host web/search tools. Resume exports need the separately declared requirements-resume.txt dependencies. It does not apply for jobs or send messages. Second-host acceptance and human usefulness remain separate from package validation.
